response.sql: WITH member_totals AS (SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) AS member_amount FROM income GROUP BY link_to_member), shares AS (SELECT member_amount, 1.0 * member_amount / SUM(member_amount) OVER () AS share FROM member_totals), compared AS (SELECT member_amount, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(member_amount) AS combined_amount, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_amount_above_average_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share
